segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר שבליל שבועות הוא העיקר התעוררות השינה שלא לישן כל הלילה ובהו"ר העיקר האמירה "שבועות איז דער עיקר דאס הוף זיין אין הושיתא רבא איז דער עיקר דאס זאגין".
segments.en: Concerning Rabbainu's shofar: after Rabbainu passed away, the story was known that he had told of the arousal he experienced from the shofar he heard on the first day of Elul — and his daughter came to him that Shabbos and said: "Father — I too had a great awakening from the shofar-blowing today," as the story is told in Sichos HaRan. And Rabbainu said then the Torah teaching in Likutay Moharan chapter 141 which begins: "If one merits, one will feel the pain of one's sins" — and this Torah and the prayer upon it in Likutay Tefilos chapter 85 are connected to the month of Elul.
